fix.shows: From the Commission's own roll data for 55 of Pilibhit's 419 booths, matched by EPIC number against the final roll of 10 April 2026, the Collective finds 2,691 entries whose names were replaced after the SIR, most of them in August, and 2,638 of them still on the roll eight days after the Chief Electoral Officer's finding on the Form 8 entries. From the Commission's Form 8 manual and the code of the ECINET and ERONET apps, it reports that a registration officer can start a correction, pass over the booth level officer's field check and approve it, that the software does not require supporting documents to be uploaded, and that the published correction forms carry no EPIC number, so the public has no reliable way to tell which entries changed. It argues that the same rules and software apply in every state.
